title: Report: Doubtful that Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah plays again

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Doubtful that Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah plays again
sources.description: Browns linebacker Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah has not played since suffering a neck injury in October 2024 and it is reportedly a long shot that he'll be able to get back on the field in the future.
